content.body:
title = Basic Map Usage 1.0.label = the map 1.1.alert = Welcome to the Theater Map tutorial. We'll learn how to move the world map around and about common things found on it.[NL][NL]Press {showingamemap} to open the theater map. 1.1.label = Open the Map
1.2.alert.modal = The map is made up of 3 distinct areas.[NL][NL]The top of the map has multiple tabs that can be used to access mission information, manuals or to change your controls. 1.2.alert.position = 211614,3074656,false 1.2.alert.scale = 1.17 1.2.alert.selection = Antwerp 1.2.alert.mouse = false 1.2.alert.hilite = -57,409,904,28,mapview 1.2.alert1.modal = On the left is the map's control panel.[NL][NL]It allows you to view map info, find towns, change map filters and perform actions like create missions, toggle radar and center the map. 1.2.alert1.hilite = -49,-4,49,407,mapview 1.2.alert2.modal = The largest portion of the map screen is devoted to the map of the world.[NL][NL]This tutorial will concentrate on this part of the map screen although we'll access a few map control functions. 1.2.alert2.hilite = -3,-1,840,403,mapview 1.2.alert3.modal = While in the game world, the map is normally centered on your position, but it is currently centered on Antwerp, a city in Belgium. 1.2.alert3.hilite = 398,69,109,51,mapview 1.2.alert5 = Center the map on your position by clicking the "center me" button on the left panel. 1.2.alert5.hilite = map-centerme 1.2.alert5.mouse = true 1.2.label = center the map 1.2.complete.modal = Clicking this button centers the map on your position no matter where you are. 1.2.complete.mouse = false
1.3.alert.modal = You are represented by the circle arrow in the center of the map.[NL][NL]The direction you are looking in the game world is the direction the arrow is pointing on the map.[NL][NL]Just like other maps: north is up, east is right, south is down and west is left. 1.3.alert.hilite = 403,178,50,43,mapview 1.3.alert1 = Now the map is centered on the Belgian city Namur.[NL][NL]Zoom all of the way into Namur by pressing {mapin} or by rolling the mouse wheel forward if you have one. 1.3.alert1.position = 233874.05,3027401.75 1.3.alert1.scale = 3.34 1.3.alert1.selection = Namur 1.3.alert1.mouse = true 1.3.label = zoom in 1.3.complete.modal = Good.[NL][NL]You can see more detail at this zoom level like buildings and structures.
1.4.alert = Now, zoom all of the way out by pressing {mapout} or by rolling the mouse wheel backwards if you have one. 1.4.label = zoom out 1.4.complete.modal = At this level, you can see much a larger region that includes many different elements, such as cities, roads, rivers, forests, and coasts.
1.5.alert = You can move the map around by left-clicking on a region of the map and dragging your mouse or by double-clicking a point on the map.[NL][NL]Move the map around. 1.5.alert.scale = 3.33 1.5.label = move the map 1.5.complete.modal = Remember, you can always re-center the map after dragging it around by clicking the "center me" button on the map control panel.
1.6.alert.modal = Sometimes its helpful to be able to find a specific city. Maybe your friends are there or the city is in danger of being captured by the enemy.[NL][NL]This is where the city finder is useful. 1.6.alert.hilite = map-cp-find 1.6.alert.scale = 3.33 1.6.alert1 = Open the city finder and enter "di" into the search box. A list of cities starting with di will show.[NL][NL]The more letters you enter, the narrower the search.[NL][NL]Select "Dinant" to center the map on that city. 1.6.alert1.hilite = map-cp-find 1.6.label = find a city 1.6.complete.modal = Well done. The map now centers on Dinant, a Belgian city on the river Meuse. 1.6.complete.mouse = false
2.0.label = Map Elements
2.1.alert.modal = Lets review some basic map elements.[NL][NL]You can learn more information about most strategic elements on the map by holding your mouse over it. 2.1.alert.position = 220238,3071580 2.1.alert.scale = 1.89 2.1.alert.selection = Antwerp 2.1.alert1.modal = Here is a group of towns on the frontline.[NL][NL]Schilde is a small town owned by the Germans.[NL][NL]To the south is Lier which is owned by the French.[NL][NL]Northwest is Antwerp, which is owned by the British. 2.1.alert1.hilite = 100,32,386,302,mapview 2.1.alert2.modal = The icon next to each town's name indicates country ownership.[NL][NL]The color of the name indicates side ownership. Red for Axis, blue for Allied.[NL][NL]Antwerp's name is currently green because it is selected. 2.1.label = chokepoints
2.2.alert.modal = Zooming in you can see Antwerp's facilities.[NL][NL]Facilities are groupings of related buildings[NL][NL]Facility types include depots, army bases, docks, airfields, factories and others. 2.2.alert.position = 214214,3074256,target 2.2.alert.scale = .91 2.2.alert.selection = Antwerp 2.2.alert1.modal = The flag next to each facility indicates which country owns the facility.[NL][NL]The icon shape indicates the facility type.[NL][NL]Once all facilities of a town are captured, the town is then owned by the capturing country and the frontline is moved forward. 2.2.label = antwerp's facilities
3.0.label = Tactical Waypoints and Contact Reports
3.1.label = origin 3.1.alert.modal = The map system also displays important tactical information such as your mission origin and target.[NL][NL]A blue triangle waypoint is placed over your mission origin.[NL][NL]Once you have completed your mission or you have run out of ammo, you should attempt to make it back here, or another friendly facility, to despawn. 3.1.alert.position = 213197,3072505,target 3.1.alert.scale = .42 3.1.alert.selection = Antwerp 3.1.alert.hilite = 282,96,76,58,mapview //3.1.alert.mouse = true 3.1.alert1.modal = If you make it back to base without too much damage, your vehicle is reserved for you.[NL][NL]If you are too damaged, you may have to take another vehicle or infantry type if no more of that type are available. 3.1.alert1.hilite = 282,96,76,58,mapview
3.2.label = target 3.2.alert.modal = A red triangle is placed on your current mission target.[NL][NL]You can right-click on any waypoint icon to make it active.[NL][NL]This adds a small green navigation arrow to your theater map and minimap. 3.2.alert.position = 220780,3073893,target 3.2.alert.hilite = 246,133,71,52,mapview 3.2.alert.selection = Schilde
3.3.alert.modal = Contact reports are points on the map where another player has reported seeing an enemy unit.[NL][NL]The report icon shape conveys the type of enemy sighted.[NL][NL]You can mouse over a report to see who reported it, when and any associated notes. 3.3.alert.position = 213197,3072505,target 3.3.alert.scale = .31 3.3.alert.selection = Antwerp 3.3.alert1 = Right-click your mouse anywhere in the map and select "Add Report".[NL][NL]Choose a type of report and enter some comments if you like.[NL][NL]Then click "OK". 3.3.alert1.mouse = true 3.3.label = add a report 3.3.complete.modal = The new report is now blinking on the map. On a real mission, the mission leader would get an alert saying a new contact had been added to the map and he would have approved it. Approved reports go to all mission members.[NL][NL]Take a moment to mouse-over the report to see its specifics.
3.4.alert = Press {showingamemap} to close the map and finish this tutorial. 3.4.label = close map
3.5.alert.modal = This concludes the Theater Map tutorial. 3.5.label = done
content.title: Map of the World
